messages:
sam: Quick postmortem follow-up — streaming chat partials/timeouts last night. Can we lock owners and an immediate short-term mitigation?
maya: I can take short-term mitigation for client-side retries/backoff + doc the expected retry window.
kevin: Thanks Maya. Can you confirm the retry window and whether we should bump client max attempts from 3 -> 5?
maya: I suggest: exponential backoff starting 200ms, max 3s, max attempts 4. Rationale: avoids overload while giving a reasonable chance to recover.
priya: From infra side I'll add a temporary increase to handshake timeout at the LB layer to 10s and monitor. That should reduce some partials caused by slow handshakes.
lia: I'll own investigating reconnect logic in SDKs — looking for cases where we drop or double-send KV cache. ETA EOD tomorrow.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-171900 - Chat streaming partials. Priority: P2.
sam: Good. Can we enumerate clear action items and deadlines here so the oncall rotation has handoff clarity?
maya: Action A1 (owner: maya) — SDK guidance: implement exponential backoff + cap attempts, update examples. Due: 1719080000 (approx 1 business day).
priya: Action A2 (owner: priya) — LB timeout bump deployed to canary, metrics dashboard (handshake latency, 4xx streaming). Due: 1719020000 (12 hours).
kevin: Action A3 (owner: kevin) — Server-side reconnect telemetry: add traces for partial-response cause codes (timeout, client-close, runtime OOM). Due: 1719120000 (2 days).
lia: Action A4 (owner: lia) — SDK reconnect test harness + regression test. Due: 1719180000 (4 days).
sam: Also add a short playbook for oncall: if partials spike > 3% over baseline for 10m, trigger rollback to older model-variant and notify infra. Lia, can you draft a one-pager?
lia: Yep — will push a gist and link here.
maya: Quick mitigation patch (SDK): diff attached below. Need review from kevin.
kevin: Skimming now. One question: are we OK with client-side caching validation after reconnect? Potential duplication risk.
maya: We'll add idempotency token prep in the next PR. Immediate PR avoids tight loop for users.
priya: Monitoring: I'm creating a grafana panel and an alert (alert rule id: STREAM_PARTIAL_RATE). Threshold: 3% over 10m. I'll include runbook link.
sam: Perfect. Let's sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to review telemetry and decide if this needs an expedited postmortem.
kevin: Ack. I'll add the telemetry fields I plan to emit here: "reconnect_reason", "kv_cache_hits", "handshake_ms", "final_status_code".
lia: For the SDK tests I'll include a flaky network simulator and validate no duplicate tokens on reconnect.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled follow-up meeting created for 1719087000 (2026-03-26 10:30 PT).
sam: Thanks all. I'll update the central action tracker and tag owners. :thumbsup:
maya: small note — we saw a pattern where partials clustered per-region (eu-west). Priya can we check node-level logs for that region?
priya: Already on it, pulling logs now. If I find a pattern I'll post snippets.
kevin: If anyone needs a quick rollback, use the rollback playbook here: https://internal.redwood/infra/rollback (read-only link).
sam: Closing the thread for now — keep updates in this thread and ping if anything blocks the 12-hour actions.
